content.article: A first deposit of €50 unlocks the Casino Welcome Bonus at Longfu88: 188% up to €2,088 plus 18 Free Spins, wagered 25x on deposit plus bonus and 40x on Free Spins winnings. Readers after the Longfu bonus find its terms and the promo code answer here, and the Longfu88 promotions follow. Players must be 18 or over.

Casino Welcome Bonus: Size and Alternatives

The Casino Welcome Bonus at Longfu88 rewards the first qualifying deposit with a match of 188% up to €2,088 plus 18 Free Spins. A minimum first deposit of €50 applies. It is for new registered players, and each account gets one welcome offer. Longfu88 also lists two alternatives: the Live Casino Welcome Bonus with 125% up to €888 and the Casino Crypto Welcome Bonus with 188% up to 2,888 USDT. Both the Casino Welcome Bonus and the Crypto Welcome Bonus are alternative first-deposit offers. In short, the standard route starts with €50.

Claiming Step by Step

Claiming the welcome bonus at Longfu88 takes four steps, and the player activates it before the first wager.

  1. Register an account and complete the required personal details.
  2. Make the first qualifying deposit.
  3. Activate the Casino Welcome Bonus in My Bonuses before placing any wagers.
  4. Play eligible casino games and complete the wagering before expiry.

The bonus is valid for 10 days from activation, so the activation in My Bonuses has to happen before any wager is placed.

Wagering and Limits

Longfu88 sets these terms for the Casino Welcome Bonus, with wagering applied to the deposit plus the bonus amount and, separately, to Free Spins winnings.

Term Value
Wagering 25x the deposit plus bonus amount
Free Spins wagering 40x Free Spins winnings
Validity 10 days from activation
Maximum bet €22.5 per spin
Maximum cashout 5x the initial bonus amount

Four rules can cost the bonus. Neteller and Skrill deposits are excluded, and only one promotional bonus may be active at a time. A withdrawal request before claiming or while the bonus is active can void promotional eligibility, and verification may be required before promotional winnings are paid.

Minimum Deposit by Offer

The minimum deposit at Longfu88 depends on the offer, and it also differs by the currency of the deposit, as the crypto offer shows.

Offer Minimum deposit
Casino Welcome Bonus €50
Live Casino Welcome Bonus €30
Casino Crypto Welcome Bonus 50 USDT
Casino Weekly Reload €30
Casino Weekend Reload €50
Casino Double Fortune: One-Day Reload Special €30

The general minimum deposit of the casino is not the minimum of an offer, so the player checks the offer first.

Longfu88 Promo Code: Is One Listed?

Longfu88 lists no promo code for its offers. Players activate the offers in My Bonuses: the Casino Welcome Bonus before the first wager, and the other offers after their eligibility and deposit conditions are met. In short, My Bonuses is where every listed offer is activated.

Where Free Spins Come From

Free spins at Longfu88 start with the Casino Weekly Reload: 50 Free Spins, minimum deposit €30, valid 7 days, with 40x winnings from Free Spins. The seasonal Casino Trick or Treat Pumpkin Bonanza offers up to 100 Free Spins for a €20 minimum deposit at 40x Free Spins winnings, and the welcome bonus adds 18 Free Spins at the same 40x. Wagering counts on spin winnings.

Cashback Rules

The Casino Weekly Cashback at Longfu88 is a rebate that returns up to 10% of weekly net casino losses, capped at €6,988. Losses are calculated from Monday 00:00 UTC through Sunday 23:59 UTC, the minimum cashback is €4.5, and the player opts in for a four-week cycle. Wagering is 10x the cashback. The Live Casino Cashback pays 25% up to €850 with 10x wagering on the credited cashback. Only real-money bets count, so bonus funds are excluded.
